package.name: dtp_perception
package.description: Perception nodes for the SUPER human detect-track-predict-follow feature (dtp-imp branch): camera-LiDAR fusion (fusion_node), the detect/track/range/predict brain wrapping detection_pipeline.HumanXZPredictor.process_frame unchanged (perception_node), target lock/re-ID/policy-inversion (target_manager, new -- no reference-repo equivalent), plus calibration validation (lidar_overlay_node) and offline non-regression replay (playback_node). See plan/dtp-imp/03 (reference reuse) and plan/dtp-imp/06 (Phase 1).
